body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #3, company drawn at random from the cheapest EV/EBITDA tercile (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.55 (naive base rate 0.08) that: Automotive Axles FY27 operating margin (resolver definition) is >= 12.0%. Our reasoning: H1 FY27 OPM 12.1% (Q1 11.6%, Q2 12.5%) on screener's operating profit / sales; H2 volume absorption vs steel/fuel conversion-cost headwinds; FY26 Q4 was 11.6%. Naive base: 0 of 11 fiscal years FY16-FY26 reached 12.0% (max 11.8% in FY19); Laplace (0+1)/(11+2) = 0.08 [SCR]. Resolution: YES if FY27 OPM (operating profit before other income / revenue from operations, as computed by the scoreboard resolver from XBRL and screener) is >= 12.0%. Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (results) + screener.in (standalone; AAL has no subsidiaries). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
